brief_summary: The goal of the study is to demonstrate whether a switch from insulin therapy to an oral therapy with pioglitazone/glimepiride will lead to a deterioration of glycemic control (increase in HbA1c by more than 0.5 %) within a 6 month observation period.
brief_title: Metabolic Effects of Pioglitazone in Type II Diabetic Patients Previously Treated With Insulin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 2 diabetes mellitus
* insulin therapy \> 1 year
* residual ß-cell function (C-peptide increase in iv glucagon test)
* written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes
* oral therapy
* life-threatening disease
* heart failure (NYHA I-IV)

lead_sponsor.name: IKFE Institute for Clinical Research and Development

official_title: Multi Center, Open Label Study to Evaluate the Influence of Pioglitazone Treatment Over 6 Months on Metabolic Control in Type II Diabetic Patients Previously Treated With Insulin

primary_outcomes.measure: The proportion of patients with an increase in HbA1c by 0.5 % after 6 months of treatment compared to baseline HbA1c value
